name: s1-round-view-plate
candidate: Run the pinned S1 with two of the provider's own knobs recalibrated while the S1 gateway executes: hsv.darkVMax 45 -> 65 and badges.plateFillMin 0.55 -> 0.45 (ports/early/earlyStore.mjs S1_ROUND_VIEW_PLATE_KNOBS). The UDisc round view draws the badge plate as a translucent black over the map (V 43-65, sd 9-20) instead of the course map's opaque near-black (V 7-10); the plate keeps its sprite size (54-57 x 42-44 px), its white frame and its numeral.
expectedBenefit: Round-view captures read their badges (therecThrown 1 -> 8 of 9, dashs5612 3 -> 6, dashs5613 3 -> 17 of 18) with no second mode: the same two numbers serve the opaque and the translucent plate.
falsifier: Any dev course's S1 badge set (label, bbox) differs from the lane-OFF run, or any course yields a badge object that is not a numbered badge. 70 and above already breaks northpark (an unlabelled extra badge), 90 breaks lenard and heritage.
provenance: provider knobs only; no provider file is edited and the pinned REPLAY-PROVENANCE hashes still verify
